inspector.cant.tooltip: How much the road rises or falls across its width, in percent. Positive values lower the right side, as on a right-hand bend. A cant given at a joined end goes to the spline joined there too.
inspector.skew.tooltip: Shifts the cross-section along the spline by this many metres per metre out from the centre line, for mitred corners: where two splines meet at a corner, one ends with the skew the other starts with, with the opposite sign. Only this spline changes.
inspector.apply_cross.tooltip: Writes the cant and skew of this spline; a changed cant is given to the splines joined at those ends.
spline.cross.failed: The cant and skew of spline #{id} could not be changed: {failure}
@spline.cross.failed: {failure} is a message of MapWorks in English
spline.cross.unchanged: The cant and skew of spline #{id} are unchanged.
spline.cross.changed: Changed the cant and skew of spline #{id}{hasJoined, select, yes { and {joined}} other {}}{hasWarnings, select, yes {; {warnings}} other {.}} Ctrl+Z takes it back.
@spline.cross.changed: {joined} lists the other splines changed, {warnings} are messages of MapWorks in English
